subject: fmath
source: Cambridge IGCSE Additional Mathematics 0606 syllabus 2025–2027, Cambridge International

weeks.topic: Functions: mappings, notation, domain and range
objectives: Use function notation and mapping diagrams
Identify domain and range, including one-one functions

weeks.topic: Composite functions
objectives: Form composite functions such as fg(x) and f²(x)
State the domain of a composite function

weeks.topic: Inverse functions and their graphs
objectives: Find f⁻¹(x) for one-one functions
Relate graphs of f and f⁻¹ by reflection in y = x

weeks.topic: Modulus functions and graphs of y = |f(x)|
objectives: Sketch y = |f(x)| for linear and quadratic f
Interpret the modulus as distance from zero

weeks.topic: Quadratic functions: completing the square, maximum and minimum values
objectives: Write quadratics in completed-square form
Find the vertex and line of symmetry

weeks.topic: The discriminant and the nature of roots
objectives: Use b² − 4ac to classify roots
Find conditions for real, equal or no real roots

weeks.topic: Quadratic inequalities
objectives: Solve quadratic inequalities using a sketch
Express solution sets in inequality notation

weeks.topic: Intersection of a line and a curve; conditions for tangency
objectives: Find points of intersection of a line and a quadratic curve
Use the discriminant to test for tangency

weeks.topic: Polynomials: the factor theorem
objectives: Use the factor theorem to find factors of cubics
Factorise cubic polynomials completely

weeks.topic: The remainder theorem and solving cubic equations
objectives: Find remainders using the remainder theorem
Solve cubic equations and find unknown coefficients

weeks.topic: Simultaneous equations: linear and non-linear
objectives: Solve one linear and one non-linear equation
Interpret the solutions graphically

weeks.topic: Surds: simplifying, rationalising and solving equations
objectives: Simplify and manipulate surds
Rationalise denominators and solve equations with surds

weeks.topic: Modulus equations and inequalities
objectives: Solve |ax + b| = |cx + d| and related equations
Solve simple modulus inequalities

weeks.topic: Sketching cubic graphs and their modulus graphs
objectives: Sketch factorised cubic polynomials
Sketch y = |f(x)| for cubics and use graphs to solve inequalities

weeks.topic: Term 1 review: functions, quadratics, polynomials and surds
objectives: Consolidate Term 1 algebra
Practise exam-style multi-part questions

weeks.topic: Laws of logarithms
objectives: Convert between index and logarithmic forms
Apply the laws of logarithms to simplify expressions

weeks.topic: Exponential functions and natural logarithms (e and ln)
objectives: Use the exponential function eˣ and ln x
Understand ln as the inverse of eˣ

weeks.topic: Solving exponential and logarithmic equations; change of base
objectives: Solve equations of the form aˣ = b
Use the change of base formula

weeks.topic: Graphs of exponential and logarithmic functions
objectives: Sketch graphs of eˣ, ln x and transformations
Identify asymptotes and intercepts

weeks.topic: Straight-line graphs: converting relationships to linear form
objectives: Transform y = axⁿ and y = abˣ to linear form using logs
Find unknown constants from a straight-line graph

weeks.topic: Coordinate geometry: lengths, midpoints, perpendicular lines and areas
objectives: Find equations of perpendicular bisectors
Calculate areas of polygons from coordinates

weeks.topic: Coordinate geometry of the circle: equation of a circle
objectives: Use (x − a)² + (y − b)² = r²
Find centre and radius by completing the square

weeks.topic: Circles: intersections with lines and tangents
objectives: Find intersections of a line and a circle
Find equations of tangents to a circle

weeks.topic: Circular measure: radians, arc length and sector area
objectives: Convert between degrees and radians
Use s = rθ and A = ½r²θ

weeks.topic: Circular measure problems: segments and compound shapes
objectives: Find areas of segments
Solve problems combining arcs, sectors and triangles

weeks.topic: Permutations: arrangements and factorial notation
objectives: Use n! and ⁿPᵣ for arrangements
Solve arrangement problems with restrictions

weeks.topic: Mid-year exams: Additional Mathematics Terms 1–2
objectives: Sit timed papers on algebra, logarithms, coordinate geometry and circular measure
Identify topics for follow-up

weeks.topic: Combinations: selections with and without restrictions
objectives: Use ⁿCᵣ for selections
Distinguish between permutation and combination problems

weeks.topic: Binomial expansion of (a + b)ⁿ for positive integer n
objectives: Expand (a + b)ⁿ using binomial coefficients
Find specific terms and coefficients

weeks.topic: Arithmetic progressions
objectives: Find the nth term and sum of an arithmetic progression
Solve problems with unknown first term or common difference

weeks.topic: Geometric progressions and sum to infinity
objectives: Find the nth term and sum of a geometric progression
Use the condition |r| < 1 for the sum to infinity

weeks.topic: Vectors in two dimensions: notation, magnitude and unit vectors
objectives: Use i, j and column vector notation
Find magnitudes and unit vectors

weeks.topic: Position vectors and vector geometry
objectives: Use position vectors to find points dividing a line
Solve geometric problems with vectors

weeks.topic: Velocity vectors and constant-velocity motion
objectives: Use r = r₀ + vt for motion
Find when objects meet or are a given distance apart

weeks.topic: Simultaneous equations involving logarithms and indices
objectives: Solve simultaneous equations with logarithmic terms
Solve simultaneous equations with exponential terms

weeks.topic: End-of-year exams: Year 10 Additional Mathematics
objectives: Sit papers on all Year 10 topics
Show full algebraic working

weeks.topic: Year 10 review and preview of trigonometry and calculus
objectives: Correct exam errors
Preview trigonometric functions and gradients of curves
